verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm whose core product is legal services, so self-hosting that product is a category error for this kind of offering. The firm also offers Visalaw AI as a hosted SaaS with a free trial, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable deployment, so the exception for actually shipping the capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
